methodology.generatedAtMeaning: Latest retained source retrieval, fixed for reproducibility; not a refresh timestamp.
methodology.asOfMeaning: Completed source daily-session date. Independent close observation times remain unavailable.
methodology.trend: Uptrend: daily close strictly above SMA20 and SMA50. Downtrend: strictly below both. Equality or disagreement is Mixed; missing averages are Unavailable. No slope or predictive strength is inferred.
methodology.momentum: RSI14 >=70 is Overbought; <=30 is Oversold; between is Neutral. These describe observations and do not predict reversals.
methodology.watch: Conditional comparisons with frozen snapshot reference levels; not monitored alerts, validated trading rules or price targets. Refresh all indicators before a later assessment.
methodology.sourceCoverage: Inherits the Desk artifact's observed-session, excluded-prefix and adjustment limitations.
